name: Crystal Clear
storyline: The player can chose to play as Red, Blue, Yellow, Gold, Silver, Green (based on the original source's manga version), Kris, a member of Team Rocket (both male and female versions), and Lana (a trainer inspired by the beta version of Red), and start either in Johto or Kanto. At the start of the game, the player can chose one of several starters, including Eevee. Because of the games open world nature, you can fight all the gym leaders in any order you want, and all roadblocks from Crystal are gone. There's also additional areas to explore before and after postgame as well with their own story beats!
summary:
Crystal Clear is an open-world Pokémon Crystal ROM hack. The game's gimmick is that Pokémon Crystal has been transformed into an open-world game with a scaling system, with various paths open to allow traversal between the two regions without story barriers or TM requirements.

Players can choose between 30 different starters, ranging from the first two starter trios plus Pikachu, baby Pokémon, and challenge starters like Unown or Smeargle. They are also able to choose between different trainer designs and choose their initial starting town. Gym Battles are scaled based on previous badges, meaning that Gyms always match the player's overall progress, no matter the order.
